_comment: Human corrections to the DLC classifier. 'dlc' forces a page to DLC; 'base' forces it to base game. 'base' is for index/hub pages that list DLC items, and for base-game pages the wiki's own markers mislabel - Godslayer Incantations is base-game content whose second lead paragraph says 'All bosses in {{SotE}} are resistant...', the one page in the snapshot where a predicate marker sits outside the definition sentence. 'dlc' is for DLC-only pages whose lead never predicates the DLC of its own subject - typically 'in {{ER}} and {{SotE}}', which reads as a both-products claim and which no rule can tell from the real thing. Both win over every automatic signal.
